title: Learning Beyond Full Imitation: Task-Preserving Knowledge Distillation
abstract: arXiv:2609.39338v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Knowledge distillation transfers knowledge by encouraging a student to match a teacher's predicted class probabilities. These probabilities express not only confidence in the correct class, but also relations among incorrect alternatives. Yet closer imitation does not necessarily yield a better student. A student may already distinguish the correct class more sharply than its teacher, so further imitation can require giving back discrimination it has acquired. Our main result is an exact separation between full imitation and conditional learning. When the correct class's score advantage over each alternative must be preserved, full teacher-to-student KL minimization is blocked exactly when the student assigns no more probability than the teacher to every incorrect class. Crucially, the teacher's relative probabilities among incorrect classes remain fully learnable. We characterize the exact price of this transfer: a minimum increase in c

translated_title: 超越完全模仿的学习：任务保持型知识蒸馏
translated_abstract: 知识蒸馏通过鼓励学生匹配教师预测的类别概率来传递知识。这些概率不仅表达了对正确类别的置信度，也表达了各个错误备选类别之间的关系。然而，更接近的模仿并不必然产生更好的学生。学生可能已经比教师更敏锐地区分出正确类别，此时进一步的模仿反而要求学生交还其已获得的判别能力。我们的主要结果是完全模仿与条件学习之间的精确分离：当必须保持正确类别相对于每个备选类别的分数优势时，恰好在学生对每个错误类别所分配的概率都不超过教师的情况下，从教师到学生的完整KL散度最小化会被阻断。至关重要的是，教师在各个错误类别之间的相对概率仍然是完全可学习的。我们刻画了这种传递的精确代价：一个最小的增加量（c……[摘要在此处截断]）
tldr: 该论文证明知识蒸馏中完全模仿与条件学习之间存在精确分离——当需保持学生对正确类别的判别优势时，完整的师生KL最小化会恰好被阻断，但教师在错误类别间的相对概率仍可完全学习，并由此刻画了任务保持型蒸馏的精确代价。
en_tdlr: The paper establishes an exact separation between full imitation and conditional learning in knowledge distillation, showing that full teacher-to-student KL minimization is blocked precisely when the student preserves its sharper discrimination of the correct class, while the teacher's relative probabilities among incorrect classes remain fully learnable, thereby characterizing the exact price of task-preserving distillation.
